constraints: Can be applied to any simple object that displays a title: buttons and 3D buttons, check boxes and 3D check boxes, radio buttons and 3D radio buttons, list box headers, static text areas, group boxes.
Do not use carriage returns in title; use the '\' character as a line return instead (permitted for 3D buttons, 3D check boxes, 3D radio buttons and list box headers).
If the object's title area is too small to hold the text, the text is truncated.

discriminatedBy.rule: When '*' is passed, object is an object name (Text) identifying the target(s) by name; when '*' is omitted, object must be a direct Variable or Field reference.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Changes the title of the form object(s) designated by object to the value passed in title.
overloadMerges.note: Merged the leading-'*' dual signature into one overload with object as a Text/Variable,Field union discriminated by '*'.
